rules.description: Six or more transactions on one account within five minutes
More than 5,000 spent on one account within an hour
Implied speed between two located transactions exceeds a commercial flight
Amount is a strong outlier against the merchant's own history
One device used by three or more accounts within the device window
High value, overnight, outside the home country
rules.when: hour_of_day < 5 and amount > 800 and country not in ('BR')
